sources.title: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1
sources.overview: MITRE ATT&CK is a globally accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations. ATT&CK for Enterprise documents adversary behavior targeting enterprise networks. Tactics describe an adversary's objective, while techniques and sub-techniques describe how that objective may be achieved. ATT&CK supports threat modeling, detection engineering, defensive coverage analysis, and incident investigation, but it does not enumerate every possible behavior or guarantee defensive coverage.
